assets.label: Multi-plex building pencil engraving
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Illustration for multi-plex row
Primary request: Use the reference crop only as visual guidance. Generate a new standalone transparent-background graphite pencil and fine ink architectural illustration of a compact three-storey urban multi-plex apartment building with a small side stair volume, front shrubs, one mature tree, and light ground hatching. Editorial real-estate marketing style, grayscale linework, subtle paper-sketch texture, crisp edges, no text, no logo, no frame, no colored background.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: Do not copy the crop exactly. No words, labels, watermark, people, cars, heavy shadows, photorealism, color fill, blueprints, or background rectangle.
